Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Moorabbin

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Moorabbin. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Moorabbin has a mix of homes, sheds and commercial buildings, and we handle roofs of every size, from a verandah to a warehouse. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Moorabbin: What We Commonly See

Moorabbin is a real mix of established 1950s and 60s post-war brick homes and a large commercial and industrial precinct of factories, warehouses and showrooms. The homes have roofs that are now well past the life of their original finish, while many of the commercial buildings carry ageing flat metal roofs and box gutters.

On homes, the jobs we see most are roofs due for replacement, cracked ridge capping and tired guttering. On commercial roofs it is rusting metal sheeting, leaking box gutters and worn flashings. We are set up to handle both.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Moorabbin

From a family home to a warehouse, replacing a worn-out roof properly is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof and re-sheet Moorabbin homes, sheds and commercial buildings in COLORBOND® steel, and we can also build and install flat metal roofing for low-pitch roofs and extensions.

Thinking about going metal? We also handle tile to tin conversions, swapping a heavy, high-maintenance roof for lightweight metal. If your roof has widespread leaks, sagging or badly rusted sheeting, talk to us about a re-roof before you keep paying for patch jobs. We will give you a straight answer on what makes the most sense for your home and budget.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Moorabbin

Our registered roof plumbers handle flashings, valleys, box gutters, downpipes and ridge capping on homes, sheds and commercial buildings. On larger roofs a failed box gutter or worn flashing can mean serious water damage, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly.

We replace guttering, downpipes and fascia capping in COLORBOND® steel, from a single damaged section through to a complete gutter replacement, and we carry out gutter repairs where a repair is all that is needed. We remove the old guttering cleanly and leave the site tidy.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Moorabbin

Every roof is different, so we quote on what is actually in front of us rather than a one-size-fits-all price. The main things that move the cost are the size and pitch of the roof, the roofing material you choose, how much guttering and flashing is involved, and how easy the roof is to access safely. We will walk you through exactly what your quote covers so there are no surprises.

Our Moorabbin Roofing Process

We start with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. For a re-roof we strip the old roof, prepare the framing, fit insulation and sarking where needed, then re-sheet in new COLORBOND® steel with fresh flashings, ridge capping, gutters and downpipes. We leave the site clean and tidy when we are done.

Why Moorabbin Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, so your job is done to standard and you are covered. As a local, family run business we treat your home the way we would treat our own, turn up when we say we will, and give honest advice rather than a hard sell. Browse the COLORBOND® colour chart to start picturing your new roof.

Moorabbin Roofing FAQs

Do you do commercial and industrial roofs?

Yes. We re-sheet and re-roof sheds, warehouses and commercial buildings, and replace box gutters and flashings on larger roofs.

Can you fix hail and storm damage?

Yes. We fix dented sheeting, damaged flashings and storm-related leaks, and can advise whether a re-roof is the better option after major damage.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
